item.subject: science
item.chapter_label: Mindful eating: a path to a healthy body
item.stem: Meena's grandmother cooks dal slowly in a clay pot over a wood fire, while Meena's mother cooks the same dal quickly in a pressure cooker on a gas stove. Which statement best explains why traditional and modern cooking practices like these differ?

options.A: They differ only because different people like different tastes.
options.B: They differ because culinary practices change over time, bringing new tools and methods.
options.C: They differ because traditional cooking is always healthier than modern cooking.
options.D: They differ because modern cooking can be done only in cities.
